annotation.authors_or_issuer: U.S. Department of Defense (Defense Acquisition Regulations System)
annotation.venue: Code of Federal Regulations (48 CFR Part 228)
annotation.summary_en: DFARS Part 228 sets Defense Department rules on performance and payment bonds and insurance in contracts. Its ground and flight risk section allocates risk of loss for government aircraft, including unmanned aerial vehicles, between the government and contractors. It sets contractor loss-share caps, revocation procedures and unallowable insurance costs.
key_provisions_or_claims: Performance and payment protections required from construction subcontractors on cost-type contracts above $40,000.
Government assumes risk of loss for covered aircraft under clause 252.228-7001, with exclusions such as willful misconduct and workmanship errors.
Contractor share of loss is the least of $200,000 or 20 percent of aircraft price or contract cost.
Contracting officer may revoke the government's assumption of risk after preliminary notice and failure to correct.
Small Group 1 and 2 unmanned aircraft below the Class C mishap cost threshold are exempt from the clause.
